parse.title: Infinity Castle Tier List
parse.text:
Information

This page classifies different units to different ranks depending on how good they are in Infinity Castle

Units are ranked based on the following statistics:

  • DPS(Damage Per Second)
  • TDPS(Total Damage Per Second)
  • SPA(Second Per Attack)
  • AoE(Area of Effect)
  • (as well as many other properties of a unit; Cost, Abilities, Effects, etc)

The ranking of each unit is based on how well they preform on each map in infinity castle This tier list ranks units based on their base stats, and their potential including buffs, supports, and relics. This tier list IS BASED ON TRAITLESS UNITS, NOT UNIQUE. Most of the units in the top of each tier happen to be the best for castle with unique as well.

Meta Support Unit
This unit has one of the BEST supporting abilities in-game!

Orwin is cheap to place and has an ability that increases the physical damage of allies in range. He gives a 25% damage increase to physical units and you can cycle these buffs to reach up to a 100% damage increase on physical units. Orwin also has the BUFF tag, making it a perfect partner for Griffin(Acension) to reach his Griffin(Reincarnation) form, allowing you to reach a 3.5x damage increase.

Placement Cost: 775¥

Placements: 6

Recommended Traits:

TDPS Calculations are based same calculations as DPS, but considers the Maximum Placements a character can have.

The Total DPS/TDPS of a unit can be higher or lower based on Passive Abilities(like Gyutaru(Moon)), or abilities that cause DMG (Anz(Overlord)) or (Julio(Wizard King))
